This library turns known failure evidence into bounded next tests. The selected
cases explain mechanisms, not benchmark prevalence: no query text, candidate
response, private identifier, raw artifact, or model rationale is shown here.

{{< include ../generated/failure-library.qmd >}}

## Continue from a mechanism to a decision

Use the [worked example](worked-example.qmd) to see where each mechanism can
appear in a synthetic ranking flow. Use the
[pre-test readiness queue](../background/pretest-readiness-plan.qmd) to see
which execution and custody work must be complete before a frozen test can run.
The [contributor lifecycle](../contributing.qmd) explains where a new evidence
bundle, correction, or falsifier belongs.
